pi.title: Estimate π
pi.summary: Throws random points in a square and counts how many fall inside the quarter circle. The share, times four, is π.

render3.title: Studio render
render3.summary: A physically based path tracer: every ray bounces up to 14 times, so glass, liquid, metal, soft light and depth of field look like a photograph. Hundreds of samples per pixel make it smooth and sharp, and take the GPU from tens of seconds to a few minutes.

render2.title: Vearl Orb
render2.short: Liquid metal · neon · GPU path tracer
render2.summary: A sphere of liquid metal swirling in blue and pink, circled by two neon rings, with glass pearls and gold balls on a mirror floor of dark tiles, and out-of-focus lights behind. Path traced on the GPU.

render.title: 3D scene
render.summary: A still life on polished stone tiles: veined marble, waxed walnut, brass, a cracked ceramic vase and a swirl-glass bowl, in soft studio light. Path traced on the GPU.

digits.title: Handwritten digits
digits.summary: A small convolutional network reads two handwritten digits. Every operation of the network is checked by exact arithmetic before the miner is paid.

matmul.title: Matrix multiplication
matmul.summary: Multiply two random int8 matrices. The product is cut into 128 × 128 blocks that miners compute; every block is checked exactly, then the result is compared with an independent computation.

gpt.title: Text generation
gpt.summary: A small language model writes a children's story word by word. Each word costs two verified jobs: the network body, then the head that scores all 50,257 words.

prompt.default: Once upon a time, there was a little cat

vit.title: Photo recognition
vit.summary: A vision transformer looks at your photo and names what it sees. Two chained jobs, every operation verified; your photo is deleted right after.
